samples.question: Match each SOURCE token to its key in both shuffled rows. ACTION gives the operation and RESULT gives its target token. Apply the matched ACTION to the SOURCE token, then select the SOURCE card whose transformed token exactly matches its matched RESULT token. Red CW means a clockwise quarter-turn; green LR means a left-right mirror; purple UD means a top-bottom mirror. Answer card-1, card-2, card-3, card-4, or card-5.
